title: Verification permissions and security updates
changes: Fixed: turning Verification off no longer deletes your channel permissions. The bot was removing the permission overwrites for your verified and unverified roles across every channel - permissions you had set yourself - which could quietly undo your whole setup
Verification setup no longer claims the bot manages your channel permissions. It assigns and removes the roles; you set which channels those roles can see, and the setup screens now say so
The verify setup menu was missing its Verified Channels option when you used the back button - it is there now
Updated dependencies to clear four security advisories, two of them high severity
